```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

path <- Sys.getenv("DATASET_PATH", unset = "data")

# Shared plot theme
plot_theme <- theme_bw(base_family = "Times") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "11", color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r capacity-constants}
# Physical cluster capacity (the 4 production hosts under analysis)
n_hosts      <- 4
ram_host_gib <- 256
vcpu_host    <- 48
oc_factor    <- 8

ram_total_gib     <- n_hosts * ram_host_gib      
vcpu_total_phy    <- n_hosts * vcpu_host         
vcpu_total_oc     <- vcpu_total_phy * oc_factor 
oc_as_frac_of_phy <- vcpu_total_oc / vcpu_total_phy
```

```{r load-data}
# Allocation is rebuilt from server-level data (see build-allocation), so we do
# not read projects_quota_allocated.csv directly.
path <- "/Users/paolamoura/Downloads/2-submit-dib/Dataset on Resource Allocation and Usage for a Private Cloud"
servers_specs      <- fread(file.path(path, "servers_specs.csv"))
servers_ownerships <- fread(file.path(path, "servers_ownerships.csv"))
flavors            <- fread(file.path(path, "flavors.csv"))
projects_quota     <- fread(file.path(path, "projects_quota.csv"))

setDT(servers_specs); setDT(servers_ownerships); setDT(flavors); setDT(projects_quota)
```

```{r dedup}
# Drop duplicate records on their natural keys before aggregating
servers_specs      <- unique(servers_specs,      by = c("server_id", "timestamp"))
servers_ownerships <- unique(servers_ownerships, by = c("server_id", "timestamp", "project_id"))
projects_quota     <- unique(projects_quota,     by = c("project_id", "timestamp"))
```

```{r build-allocation}
# Allocated capacity = sum of the flavor sizes of the running VMs, per project and
# timestamp. Servers on the RESERVE host (reservation flavors) are NOT part of the
# 4 hosts under analysis, so they are excluded entirely.
flavors[, `:=`(vcpu = as.numeric(vcpu), ram = as.numeric(ram))]

server_time_capacity <- flavors[servers_specs, on = "flavor_id"][
  , .(server_id, timestamp, flavor_id, vcpu, ram)
]

# Servers that ever used a reservation flavor -> drop them entirely
reservation_flavors  <- flavors[grepl("^reservation:", flavor_name), flavor_id]
reservation_servers  <- server_time_capacity[flavor_id %in% reservation_flavors, unique(server_id)]
server_time_capacity <- server_time_capacity[!server_id %in% reservation_servers]

# Static server -> project map (a VM does not change project)
server_project_map <- unique(servers_ownerships[, .(server_id, project_id)], by = "server_id")

server_time_capacity_proj <- server_project_map[server_time_capacity, on = "server_id"][
  !is.na(project_id), .(server_id, timestamp, project_id, vcpu, ram)
]

# Aggregate to project x timestamp
alloc_proj_ts <- server_time_capacity_proj[, .(
  vcpu_allocated = sum(vcpu, na.rm = TRUE),
  ram_allocated  = sum(ram, na.rm = TRUE)   # MB
), by = .(project_id, timestamp)][order(project_id, timestamp)]
```

```{r coerce-types}
projects_quota[, `:=`(
  project_id = as.character(project_id),
  timestamp  = as.numeric(timestamp),
  quota_ram  = as.numeric(quota_ram),    # MB
  quota_vcpu = as.numeric(quota_vcpu)
)]

alloc_proj_ts[, `:=`(
  project_id = as.character(project_id),
  timestamp  = as.numeric(timestamp)
)]
```

```{r to-date-helper}
# All daily series use the value in effect at the END OF DAY (UTC).
# Quota is a step function (discrete events) and allocation is sampled every
# 5 min; taking the last sample of each day keeps both series comparable.
to_utc_date <- function(ts) as.Date(as.POSIXct(ts, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"))
```

```{r quota-cluster-timeseries}
# Time grid starts at the first quota snapshot
t0_quota <- min(projects_quota$timestamp)
ts_vec   <- sort(unique(alloc_proj_ts$timestamp))
ts_vec   <- ts_vec[ts_vec >= t0_quota]

# Exclude projects whose entire footprint is on the reserve host (reservation
# VMs only, no regular VM): the reserve host is outside the 4 analyzed hosts, so
# its quota must not be counted either.
resv_projects        <- unique(as.character(server_project_map[server_id %in% reservation_servers, project_id]))
active_projects      <- unique(as.character(alloc_proj_ts$project_id))
reservation_only     <- setdiff(resv_projects, active_projects)

# Project x timestamp grid + roll join (last quota value <= timestamp)
all_projects <- sort(setdiff(unique(projects_quota$project_id), reservation_only))
grid <- CJ(project_id = all_projects, timestamp = ts_vec, unique = TRUE)
setkey(grid, project_id, timestamp)
setkey(projects_quota, project_id, timestamp)

quota_state <- projects_quota[grid, on = .(project_id, timestamp), roll = TRUE]
quota_state[is.na(quota_ram),  quota_ram  := 0]   # project did not exist yet
quota_state[is.na(quota_vcpu), quota_vcpu := 0]

# Cluster-level quota per timestamp + capacity fractions
quota_cluster_ts <- quota_state[, .(
  quota_ram_gib = sum(quota_ram) / 1024,  # MB -> GiB
  quota_vcpu    = sum(quota_vcpu)
), by = timestamp]

quota_cluster_ts[, `:=`(
  frac_ram_phy  = quota_ram_gib / ram_total_gib,
  frac_vcpu_phy = quota_vcpu    / vcpu_total_phy,
  date          = to_utc_date(timestamp)
)]

# Daily series: quota in effect at end of day
setorder(quota_cluster_ts, date, timestamp)
quota_cluster_day <- quota_cluster_ts[, .SD[.N], by = date]
```

```{r quota-lines-long}
quota_lines_wide <- quota_cluster_day %>%
  transmute(
    date_utc        = date,
    ram_quota       = frac_ram_phy,
    ram_physical    = 1,
    vcpu_quota      = frac_vcpu_phy,
    vcpu_physical   = 1,
    vcpu_overcommit = oc_as_frac_of_phy
  )

ram_long <- quota_lines_wide %>%
  select(date_utc, quota = ram_quota, physical = ram_physical) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(quota, physical), names_to = "series", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(resource_label = "RAM",
         series = recode(series, quota = "Provisioned quota", physical = "Physical capacity"))

vcpu_long <- quota_lines_wide %>%
  select(date_utc, quota = vcpu_quota, physical = vcpu_physical, overcommit = vcpu_overcommit) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(quota, physical, overcommit), names_to = "series", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(resource_label = "vCPU",
         series = recode(series, quota = "Provisioned quota", physical = "Physical capacity",
                         overcommit = "Capacity with overcommit"))

cluster_lines_long <- bind_rows(ram_long, vcpu_long) %>%
  mutate(resource_label = factor(resource_label, levels = c("RAM", "vCPU")),
         series = factor(series, levels = c("Provisioned quota", "Physical capacity",
                                            "Capacity with overcommit")))
```

```{r plot-quota-lines, fig.height=6, fig.width=6.5}
xmin <- min(cluster_lines_long$date_utc, na.rm = TRUE)
xmax <- max(cluster_lines_long$date_utc, na.rm = TRUE)
breaks_m <- seq(as.Date(format(xmin, "%Y-%m-01")), as.Date(format(xmax, "%Y-%m-01")), by = "1 month")
breaks_m <- breaks_m[breaks_m >= xmin & breaks_m <= xmax]

p_quota_lines <- ggplot(cluster_lines_long,
                        aes(date_utc, value, linetype = series, color = series)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ resource_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_x_date(limits = c(xmin, xmax), breaks = breaks_m,
               labels = function(x) format(x, "%b"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Resource level (% of physical capacity)") +
  plot_theme + theme(legend.key.width = unit(0.8, "cm"))

p_quota_lines
ggsave("cluster-quota-vs-capacity.png", p_quota_lines, width = 6.5, height = 5.5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

```{r alloc-cluster-daily}
# Cluster-level allocation per timestamp + capacity fractions
alloc_cluster_ts <- alloc_proj_ts[, .(
  ram_gib = sum(ram_allocated) / 1024,  # MB -> GiB
  vcpu    = sum(vcpu_allocated)
), by = timestamp]

alloc_cluster_ts[, `:=`(
  frac_ram_phy  = ram_gib / ram_total_gib,
  frac_vcpu_phy = vcpu    / vcpu_total_phy,
  date          = to_utc_date(timestamp)
)]

# Daily series: allocation in effect at end of day (same convention as quota)
setorder(alloc_cluster_ts, date, timestamp)
alloc_cluster_day <- alloc_cluster_ts[, .SD[.N], by = date]
```

```{r plot-alloc-lines, fig.height=6, fig.width=6.5}
ram_long_a <- alloc_lines_wide %>%

vcpu_long_a <- alloc_lines_wide %>%

  pivot_longer(c(allocated, physical, overcommit), names_to = "series", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(resource_label = "vCPU",
         series = recode(series, allocated = "Allocated resources", physical = "Physical capacity",
                         overcommit = "Capacity with overcommit"))

cluster_alloc_long <- bind_rows(ram_long_a, vcpu_long_a) %>%

xmin <- min(cluster_alloc_long$date_utc); xmax <- max(cluster_alloc_long$date_utc)

               labels = function(x) format(x, "%b"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +

p_alloc_lines
ggsave("cluster-allocation-vs-capacity.png", p_alloc_lines, width = 6.5, height = 5.5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

```{r min-flavor}
# Reference = smallest flavor a user could launch (reservation flavors excluded)
real_flavors <- flavors[!grepl("^reservation:", flavor_name)]
setorder(real_flavors, vcpu, ram)
min_vcpu <- real_flavors[1, vcpu]
min_ram  <- real_flavors[1, ram]
```

```{r build-panel}
# Quota in effect at each (project, timestamp) of the allocation series.
# Every project has a quota, and projects_quota records only CHANGES, so the first
# recorded value also holds for earlier periods: we carry it BACKWARD as well as
# forward (rollends = c(TRUE, TRUE)), instead of treating pre-record periods as 0.
alloc_keys <- unique(alloc_proj_ts[, .(project_id, timestamp)])
setkey(alloc_keys, project_id, timestamp)
setkey(projects_quota, project_id, timestamp)
quota_ts <- projects_quota[alloc_keys, roll = TRUE, rollends = c(TRUE, TRUE)]

# A few projects run VMs but have no quota record at all; their quota cannot be
# determined, so they are excluded from the quota-based (potential-failure)
# analysis. This keeps the denominator consistent with the quota-utilization view.
projects_without_quota <- quota_ts[, .(all_na = all(is.na(quota_ram))), by = project_id][all_na == TRUE, project_id]
quota_ts <- quota_ts[!project_id %in% projects_without_quota]

setkey(alloc_proj_ts, project_id, timestamp)
setkey(quota_ts,      project_id, timestamp)
panel <- quota_ts[alloc_proj_ts, nomatch = NULL]   # inner join: only projects with a quota

panel[, `:=`(remaining_vcpu = quota_vcpu - vcpu_allocated,
             remaining_ram  = quota_ram  - ram_allocated)]
panel[, `:=`(potential_failure = (remaining_vcpu < min_vcpu) | (remaining_ram < min_ram),
             out_of_quota      = (remaining_vcpu <= 0)        | (remaining_ram <= 0))]
panel[, date := to_utc_date(timestamp)]
```

```{r pf-aggregates}
# Per timestamp
pf_ts <- panel[, .(
  n_projects = uniqueN(project_id),
  frac_pf = mean(potential_failure), frac_ooq = mean(out_of_quota),
  n_pf = sum(potential_failure),     n_ooq = sum(out_of_quota)
), by = .(timestamp, date)]

# Per project
pf_by_project <- panel[, .(
  pct_pf  = 100 * mean(potential_failure, na.rm = TRUE),
  pct_ooq = 100 * mean(out_of_quota,      na.rm = TRUE),
  n_obs   = .N
), by = project_id]
```

```{r analysis-daily}
# Reuse the per-timestamp cluster allocation (frac_ram_phy already computed),
# join the potential-failure rate, and reduce to end of day (same convention).
pf_alloc_ts <- pf_ts[alloc_cluster_ts, on = .(timestamp, date)]
setorder(pf_alloc_ts, date, timestamp)
pf_alloc_day <- pf_alloc_ts[, .SD[.N], by = date]

analysis_daily <- pf_alloc_day[, .(date, frac_pf, frac_ooq, frac_ram_phy, frac_vcpu_phy)]
analysis_daily <- analysis_daily[is.finite(frac_pf) & is.finite(frac_ram_phy) & is.finite(frac_vcpu_phy)]
```

```{r plot-loess, fig.height=3, fig.width=6}
ggplot(analysis_daily, aes(frac_ram_phy, frac_pf)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2.5, color = "#2c7fb8") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = "Allocated RAM (% of physical capacity)", y = "Projects in potential failure") +
  plot_theme
ggsave("potential-failure-vs-ram-pressure.png", width = 6.5, height = 3.2, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

```{r plot-size-vs-pf, fig.height=3, fig.width=6}
proj_size <- alloc_proj_ts[, .(
  mean_ram_gib = mean(ram_allocated, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024,
  p95_ram_gib  = quantile(ram_allocated, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) / 1024,
  mean_vcpu    = mean(vcpu_allocated, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = project_id]

pf_proj <- merge(pf_by_project, proj_size, by = "project_id", all.x = TRUE)

ggplot(pf_proj, aes(mean_ram_gib, pct_pf / 100)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2.5, color = "#2c7fb8") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = "Project size (mean allocated RAM, GB)", y = "Time in potential failure") +
  plot_theme
ggsave("potential-failure-vs-project-size.png", width = 6.5, height = 3.2, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

```{r plot-pf-histogram, fig.height=3, fig.width=6}
pf_project <- panel[, .(frac_pf = mean(potential_failure, na.rm = TRUE)), by = project_id]

ggplot(pf_project, aes(frac_pf)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(count) / sum(after_stat(count))),
                 binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0, closed = "left",
                 fill = "#2c7fb8", color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +

  plot_theme
```

```{r plot-quota-profiles, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
# Exclude reservation-only projects (footprint entirely on the reserve host), so
# reservation is left out of the quota-profile analysis as well.
latest_quota <- projects_quota[!project_id %in% reservation_only, .SD[which.max(timestamp)], by = project_id]
latest_quota[, quota_ram_gb := quota_ram / 1024]

ref_project <- latest_quota[order(quota_vcpu, quota_ram_gb)][1]
latest_quota[, `:=`(quota_vcpu_norm = quota_vcpu  / ref_project$quota_vcpu,
                    quota_ram_norm  = quota_ram_gb / ref_project$quota_ram_gb)]

ggplot(latest_quota, aes(quota_vcpu_norm, quota_ram_norm)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2c7fb8", size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max(latest_quota$quota_vcpu_norm)) + 5, 5),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max(latest_quota$quota_ram_norm)) + 5, 5),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "vCPU quota (normalized by the smallest project)",
       y = "RAM quota (normalized by the smallest project)") +
  plot_theme
ggsave("quota-profiles-per-project-normalized.png", width = 6.5, height = 4.5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

```{r plot-quota-utilization, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=6}
# Per-project RAM quota utilization over the observation period, showing the
# heterogeneity between projects pinned at their quota ceiling and projects that
# retain unused allocation rights. Reuses `panel` (quota_ram, ram_allocated per
# project x timestamp). Projects with no quota record (quota_ram == 0) are excluded.
quota_util_proj <- panel[quota_ram > 0, .(
  used = mean(pmin(ram_allocated / quota_ram, 1), na.rm = TRUE)  # cap at 100% for display
), by = project_id]
quota_util_proj[, unused := 1 - used]
setorder(quota_util_proj, used)
quota_util_proj[, rank := .I]

med_util <- median(quota_util_proj$used)

quota_util_long <- melt(
  quota_util_proj[, .(rank, Used = used, Unused = unused)],
  id.vars = "rank", variable.name = "part", value.name = "frac"
)
quota_util_long[, part := factor(part, levels = c("Unused", "Used"))]

ggplot(quota_util_long, aes(rank, frac, fill = part)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = med_util, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = med_util + 0.03,
           label = sprintf("median %.0f%%", 100 * med_util),
           hjust = 0, size = 4, family = "Times") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Used = "#2c7fb8", Unused = "grey80"),
                    breaks = c("Used", "Unused"),
                    labels = c("Allocated (used) quota", "Unused allocation rights")) +
  labs(x = "Projects (ordered by RAM quota utilization)", y = "Share of RAM quota") +
  plot_theme + theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"))
ggsave("quota-utilization-per-project.png", width = 6.5, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```
